description: Is the second GTP site in 2FP4 reproduced in the five other pig SCS nucleotide complexes, and how buried is it?
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
AA3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL','MSE','NEP'}

PIG=["2FP4","2FPG","7JFP","7JMK","7JJ0","7JKR"]   # pig GTP-specific SCS, same protein
PATCH=[55,56,57,64,65]    # beta residues contacting GTP 404 in 2FP4 (author numbering)

def fetch(pid):
    return S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text

def parse(txt):
    at=[]   # (rec,name,resn,chain,resi,x,y,z,occ,b)
    meta={"sg":None,"res":None}
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if L.startswith("CRYST1"): meta["sg"]=L[55:66].strip()+" | cell "+L[6:33].strip()
        if L.startswith("REMARK   2 RESOLUTION."): meta["res"]=L[23:].strip()
        if L.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
            alt=L[16]
            if alt not in (" ","A"): continue
            try: xyz=(float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54]))
            except: continue
            at.append((L[:6].strip(),L[12:16].strip(),L[17:20].strip(),L[21],L[22:27].strip(),
                       xyz[0],xyz[1],xyz[2],float(L[54:60] or 1),float(L[60:66] or 0)))
    return at,meta

rows=[]; store={}
for pid in PIG:
    at,meta=parse(fetch(pid)); store[pid]=(at,meta)
    # chain lengths (polymer residues)
    cres=defaultdict(set)
    for r in at:
        if r[0]=="ATOM" and r[2] in AA3: cres[r[3]].add(r[4])
    # pick beta chain = longest
    beta=max(cres,key=lambda c:len(cres[c]))
    hets=sorted({(r[2],r[3],r[4]) for r in at if r[0]=="HETATM" and r[2] not in AA3 and r[2]!="HOH"})
    rows.append({"pdb":pid,"resolution":meta["res"],"spacegroup_cell":meta["sg"],
                 "chains":",".join(f"{c}:{len(cres[c])}" for c in sorted(cres)),
                 "beta_chain":beta,"n_het":len(hets),
                 "het":";".join(f"{h[0]}{h[2]}/{h[1]}" for h in hets if h[0] not in ("GOL","EDO","PEG","SO4","CL","NA","K"))[:70]})
print(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))
print()

# patch occupancy test: any non-water heteroatom within 5.0 A of beta patch residues
patch_tab=[]
for pid in PIG:
    at,meta=store[pid]
    cres=defaultdict(set)
    for r in at:
        if r[0]=="ATOM" and r[2] in AA3: cres[r[3]].add(r[4])
    beta=max(cres,key=lambda c:len(cres[c]))
    P=np.array([[r[5],r[6],r[7]] for r in at if r[0]=="ATOM" and r[3]==beta and r[4] in [str(i) for i in PATCH]])
    present=sorted({r[4]+r[2] for r in at if r[0]=="ATOM" and r[3]==beta and r[4] in [str(i) for i in PATCH]})
    if len(P)==0:
        patch_tab.append({"pdb":pid,"patch_res_modelled":"none","ligands_within_5A":"-","n_wat_5A":0}); continue
    lig=defaultdict(float)
    nwat=0
    for r in at:
        if r[0]!="HETATM": continue
        d=np.sqrt(((P-np.array(r[5:8]))**2).sum(1)).min()
        if d<=5.0:
            if r[2]=="HOH": nwat+=1
            else: lig[f"{r[2]}{r[4]}/{r[3]}"]=min(lig.get(f"{r[2]}{r[4]}/{r[3]}",99),d)
    patch_tab.append({"pdb":pid,"patch_res_modelled":",".join(present),
                      "ligands_within_5A":"; ".join(f"{k}({v:.1f}A)" for k,v in sorted(lig.items(),key=lambda x:x[1])) or "NONE",
                      "n_wat_5A":nwat})
pt=pd.DataFrame(patch_tab)
print("Is the 2FP4 GTP404 surface patch (beta Gly55,Lys56,Gly57,Lys64,Gly65) occupied in other pig SCS crystals?")
print(pt.to_string(index=False))
print()

# burial comparison: protein heavy atoms within 5 A of each nucleotide atom, 2FP4 site I vs site II
at,_=store["2FP4"]
prot=np.array([[r[5],r[6],r[7]] for r in at if r[0]=="ATOM" and r[2] in AA3])
def burial(resi):
    sel=[r for r in at if r[0]=="HETATM" and r[2]=="GTP" and r[4]==resi]
    return [(r[1], int((np.sqrt(((prot-np.array(r[5:8]))**2).sum(1))<=5.0).sum()), r[9]) for r in sel]
b403=burial("403"); b404=burial("404")
print(f"2FP4 GTP403 (catalytic): {len(b403)} atoms, mean protein neighbours within 5A = {np.mean([x[1] for x in b403]):.1f}, mean B = {np.mean([x[2] for x in b403]):.1f}")
print(f"2FP4 GTP404 (second)   : {len(b404)} atoms, mean protein neighbours within 5A = {np.mean([x[1] for x in b404]):.1f}, mean B = {np.mean([x[2] for x in b404]):.1f}")
print(f"GTP404 atoms with ZERO protein neighbour within 5A: {sum(1 for x in b404 if x[1]==0)}/{len(b404)}")
print(f"GTP403 atoms with ZERO protein neighbour within 5A: {sum(1 for x in b403 if x[1]==0)}/{len(b403)}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
names=[x[0] for x in b403]; idx=np.arange(len(b403))
d403={x[0]:x[1] for x in b403}; d404={x[0]:x[1] for x in b404}
common=[n for n in names if n in d404]
w=0.4; i=np.arange(len(common))
ax[0].bar(i-w/2,[d403[n] for n in common],w,label="GTP 403, catalytic site I",color="#2b6cb0")
ax[0].bar(i+w/2,[d404[n] for n in common],w,label="GTP 404, second copy",color="#c05621")
ax[0].set_xticks(i); ax[0].set_xticklabels(common,rotation=90,fontsize=6)
ax[0].set_ylabel("protein heavy atoms within 5 A"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("2FP4: burial of the two GTP copies, atom by atom",fontsize=10)
ax[1].axis("off")
tbl=[[r["pdb"],r["patch_res_modelled"][:22],r["ligands_within_5A"][:34],r["n_wat_5A"]] for r in patch_tab]
t=ax[1].table(cellText=tbl,colLabels=["PDB","patch residues modelled","non-water ligand within 5 A","waters"],loc="center",cellLoc="left")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7); t.scale(1,1.4)
ax[1].set_title("Occupancy of the beta 55-57/64-65 patch across six pig SCS crystals",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
